description: In the Trash table the DELETED timestamp and the RECOVERY text are cut off with ellipses ('11/6/2026…', 'Versions preser…') while the MODIFIED column holds only '—' and wastes width.
expected: Full deletion date/time visible; the 'Versions preserved' label readable.
actual: DELETED cell needs 192px but is 110px wide; time of deletion not visible.
suggested_fix: Rebalance column widths (drop MODIFIED or make it flex), allow DELETED to wrap.

description: In the Versions dialog for a trashed file every version has 'Restore this version' and none is marked Current; after a restore the newest 'Console' version looks identical (size, time) to the one below it.
expected: Mark the latest version, or label the Console restore row 'Restored from ...'.
suggested_fix: Show 'latest' on the top row and the source of a restore.

description: After trashing a filtered file, the list says 'No loaded files match “draft”' and offers 'Load more files' even when everything is loaded, implying there could be more matches.
expected: Show 'Load more' only if more pages exist (the footer said 0 of 100 while 115 files exist, so here it is correct) and word the empty state around the filter.
actual: Reads as if the file might still be elsewhere.
suggested_fix: Hide the button when the last page is loaded.

description: The Trash tab shows 'KEY REQUIRED FOR DOWNLOADS' and a 'Load drive key' button though no action on this tab downloads or decrypts anything.
actual: Visible on Trash, desktop and mobile.
